meta.name: itr-wala
meta.description: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax, advance tax, or the income-tax e-filing portal - even if they just say "help me with my taxes" in an Indian context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成印度个税申报与税务核对
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果居住在印度需要自己报税或核对税务
copy.tagline_en: Compute, file, and verify Indian income tax returns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file Indian taxes and reconcile tax details yourself

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会引导你完成印度2025-26财年个人所得税申报:收集并核对Form 16、AIS等文件,用内置脚本计算税额和退税,比较新旧税制,生成申报材料,并告诉你何时点提交和验证。
howto.when: 当你说要处理印度税务(报税、计税、比较税制等)、股票或加密货币的资本利得,或提到ITR表格、80C/80D等术语时;印度语境下说“帮我处理税务”也会触发。

say.note: 它会核对文件,核对TDS并计算税额。

say.text: 帮我比较旧税制和新税制,哪个更划算?
say.note: 它会用引擎输出对比和推荐。

say.text: 这是Zerodha的股票对账单,帮我算资本利得。
say.note: 它会提取交易数据并按规定分类。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through Indian ITR filing for FY 2025-26: checks Form 16/AIS, computes tax/refund via scripts, compares tax regimes, generates filing pack, and tells you when to pay/submit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention handling Indian taxes (filing, computing, regime comparison, etc.), capital gains from stocks or crypto, or ITR forms/sections like 80C/80D; even just 'help me with my taxes' in an Indian context works.

say_en.text: I want to file my ITR for FY 2025-26; I have Form 16 and AIS.
say_en.note: It cross-checks documents, reconciles TDS, and computes tax.

say_en.text: Compare old vs new tax regime for me. Which is better?
say_en.note: It shows the engine's comparison and recommendation.

say_en.text: Here's my Zerodha statement; compute my capital gains.
say_en.note: It extracts and classifies gains per rules.
